card.name: Hazard and toxicity handling text
card.fires_on: Small connecting words, digits and spaces inside hazard, toxicity and handling passages, such as lethal-dose figures, skin-contact warnings and flammability wording. It fires on filler positions, not on one fixed word.

modes.description: Linking words or punctuation in skin-contact, disposal or reference-pointer sentences.

modes.description: Small words in sentences about flammability or hazard class.

card.writes: It pushes toward safety-sheet words such as Safety, Material, SDS and MSD, as in a Material Safety Data Sheet.
card.plain: It marks spots in hazard and toxicity text where a reference to a safety data sheet might come next.
